title: Hearing Cal Tjader at Dave's
summary: A Saturday afternoon session with Cal Tjader made Monk feel he had to play something different.

story.theme_name: Playing with Coltrane and the avant-garde

blocks.x: And I remember, I was going to Dave's Fifth Avenue on Saturday afternoon, because we worked at night and they had jam sessions on Saturday afternoons. (This remark cut off by tape.) Cal Tjader was working that day and on Saturday, that afternoon, I had gone over there and people were just lined up to get in. I got inside the room and I was standing, because the place was just jammed.
And Cal sounded...great artist and has sound. And it did something to me, like, wow, I just got to play different than what I'm playing. I got to play something. I got to play.

It was close to the holidays, the Christmas holidays. And I was going to go home for Christmas and I was afraid I wasn't going to come back. I was really afraid of that, that I wasn't going to come back. I wouldn't want to come back.
